title: demo-triage: answer high-priority tickets sooner
body:
## Summary
demo-triage assigns tickets by arrival time only, so a new P1 ticket waits behind older low-priority ones.

## Proposal
1. Under the condition that a ticket is P1 and has waited more than one hour, assign it before all others.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Given a P1 ticket that has waited two hours and an older P3 ticket, the P1 ticket is assigned first.

title: demo-triage: assign by priority class
body:
## Summary
demo-triage has no rule for lower priorities.

## Proposal
1. Under the condition that a ticket is P2, assign it after the P1 tickets that arrived before it.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Given a P1 ticket that arrived before a P2 ticket, the P1 ticket is assigned first.
